transcript.text: I've got the savings to actually start
something, but every idea I come up
with, 2 minutes of research shows me 10
people already doing it. How do you pick
something to actually go all in on when
nothing feels original anymore?
>> I think that you don't need to be
original. Let me reframe what you're
saying. People want the service or
product that I'm considering and there's
a clear market and demand for it. I
don't want to go there. I want to go
where there's absolutely no proven
demand for this thing. It's like if you
say it like that, it's like, well, no,
I'd rather go where the fish are, right?
What you're describing is just the
nature of capitalism. There's going to
be competition. So, let's play this out
a little further. Let's say you you
somehow find a unicorn product that no
one else has ever made before. What do
you think happens next? Other people are
going to copy your thing. Yes, there's
probably going to be people in whatever
space you're in, but they're probably
not going to be in every single
marketing channel. They're probably not
going to be segmented every single
avatar. All you have to do is think
smaller. So, hear me out. You want to
think, is there a very underserved
avatar within this specific product? Is
there a market that I can go after that
are people are not speaking to well? By
the way, I think best person to start
with is you. Are there any products that
you think could be done better with you
as the customer because you don't need
to do the market research. You are the
market research. And then secondly, is
there a unique way that I can uh
get them to find out of my stuff that
other people are not on, right? Like
TikTok Shop, things like that are are
blowing up, selling on Whatnot. These
are all newer platforms that some of you
know, existing players aren't on yet.
And so, the opportunity is both in who
we're serving and how we're reaching
them. Both of those things can be unique
levers that you can pull in order to
actually take something that might be
otherwise already done and make it new.
